title: Astras — client management
encryptorIntro: Enter the terminal addresses and authorized clients, then save an encrypted configuration for Astras Manager. This tool works offline.
encryptorClientHint: Client IDs must be unique and match the clientid in each client's JWT. Names are shown in the manager's account selector.
encryptorPasswordHint: Use at least {min} characters. The manager will enter this password to unlock the file.
encryptorPasswordError: Passwords must match and contain at least {min} characters.
encryptorConfigError: Check the HTTPS addresses, unique client IDs, names and refresh tokens. Every client field is required.
encryptorSaveError: Could not save the configuration. Choose a writable location and a filename ending in .enc, then try again.
encryptorSaved:
Saved: {path}
Place clients.enc beside AstrasManager.exe. Client entries and passwords have been cleared.
encryptorCancelled: Save cancelled. Your entries are still available.
locked: Enter the password for the clients.enc file beside this application.
configMissing: Could not read clients.enc. Place the file beside the application.
authenticationError: Could not sign in. Check the connection and the client's token validity.
identityError: The token belongs to another client. Check clientId in the configuration.
loadError: Could not load the terminal. Check the address and connection, then select the client again.
sessionError: The session ended or navigation was blocked. Select the client again.
passwordRules: Passwords must match and contain at least 12 characters.
encryptUsage: Usage: npm run encrypt -- private/clients.json private/clients.enc
encrypted: File encrypted. Distribute only clients.enc; share the password separately.
encryptError: Could not encrypt the file. Check the JSON and paths, use a new output file and an interactive terminal.
